name: Emre Tezmen
note: Businessman, co-founder and chairman of Tera Holding; described in press as its main owner and largest shareholder (tera-tezmen-ownership). Personal (family) ownership, treated as a private owner, not a state. His father Oğuz Tezmen, a former transport minister, is reported to hold 25.17% of the group. Emre Tezmen was placed under a travel ban and questioned in September 2026 in Turkey's 'fund crisis' investigation; that is a financial-market record, which does not count for ratings under METHOD.md.
